scope: Read-only review of S1-S4 corrections and the supplemental-truth/shared-output-budget interfaces. No test execution or scorer edits.

source_evidence: score_arm validates every asserted available scalar output and invalidates its transaction on a nonfinite value.
The binary64 clock is required to equal the preceding valid chronological clock plus actual dt. Mismatched time does not seed subsequent expected time.
findings.test_evidence: test_asserted_available_nonfinite_voltage_and_exact_clock_invalidate covers both voltage fields, an incorrect finite clock, and legitimate masked NaN placeholders.

source_evidence: expected_grid requires the sorted unique intended grid with arm entry/end and the declared record bound.
full_query_scores verifies its prefix through the consumed endpoint, additionally requires the stopped endpoint, and records missing/out-of-arm/future/unexpected query issues.
No supplied grid cannot yield completed_valid_arm=true; full-query integrity issues invalidate arm completion and later window claims.
findings.test_evidence: test_required_query_grid_missing_future_duplicate_and_absent_contract covers an initial-only query file, future rows on an incomplete scalar prefix, duplicate indices and absent required grid.

source_evidence: natural validates finite16 coordinates and finite positive transformed log parameters; invalid required estimate/truth vectors produce indexed integrity issues.
Asserted available local ranges require finite ordered bounds and valid16 nonnegative SDs.
Unavailable interval/SD placeholders remain allowed and explicitly unavailable. Invalid full data cannot silently preserve valid arm or retention completion.
findings.test_evidence: test_nonfinite_required_vectors_and_asserted_ranges_invalidate covers estimate/truth vectors, reversed local range, invalid available SD and legitimate unavailable placeholders.

source_evidence: Target.result includes a passing learned entry in first_observed_hit and separately preserves first_interval_end_hit.
Entry metadata distinguishes learned phase/restore evidence from initial/cold raw priors, which remain excluded.
findings.test_evidence: test_retention_entry_and_within_preferred_drift verifies learned entry, interval-only first hit, preferred retention and initial-prior exclusion.

additional_interfaces_reviewed.supplemental_truth: merged_truth_rows holds one pending row per stream, preserves sorted global indices and rejects conflicting duplicates. The existing full truth is reused rather than copied.
additional_interfaces_reviewed.output_cap: OutputBudget counts actual gzip writes/framing plus summary bytes under one per-arm allowance, checks before write, and reserves4096 bytes for failure capture.
additional_interfaces_reviewed.runner_call_sites: tools/run_continuous_learning.py currently supplies required_query_indices, remaining max_output_bytes and supplemental_full_truth when present.
additional_interfaces_reviewed.window_validity: After integrity issues, valid_through_index prevents any later incomplete/invalid window from claiming full retention or sustained-to-end accuracy; raw prefix statistics remain labeled available.

scope_limit: This closes the specific scorer findings by static review and inspection of the owner qualification receipt. It is not a primary-result claim or a replacement for the root coupled preflight/resource gates.
